title: Nvidia secures substrate capacity as South Korean chip startups face supply squeeze
html:
Nvidia is securing more advanced chip substrate capacity through long-term supply agreements as South Korea's AI chip startups struggle to obtain key components, while Seoul seeks closer cooperation between domestic suppliers and chip developers.

Credit: AFP
